info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Documents-v5-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Document Retrieval API enables users to efficiently access and retrieve a list of documents related to insurance claims. This endpoint is designed for claims adjusters and administrative personnel who need to reference claim documentation for processing or auditing purposes. The API supports the retrieval of various document types associated with specific claims, streamlining the management of claim-related information. Typical use cases include verifying documentation and facilitating claims resolution through easy access to relevant files.

get.summary: Retrieve all documents associated with claims.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of documents linked to claims in the system. It supports pagination and filtering to enhance data retrieval.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving documents related to claims. This object should contain the necessary parameters for the GET operation, structured according to the specified schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of claim documents.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsDocumentsReques.title: Claims Documents Request Body
